name: viewcam-codec
description: Byte-shuffle + zstd decoder and dequantizer for viewcam frames, as a WASM module for web workers

scripts.postbuild:wasm: cp js/decode-worker.js pkg/ && cp THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.txt pkg/ && node -e "const p=require('./pkg/package.json'); p.files.push('decode-worker.js','THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.txt'); require('fs').writeFileSync('./pkg/package.json', JSON.stringify(p, null, 2));"
